bundle.shortDescription: Archive and browse your iMessage/SMS history, forever.
bundle.longDescription: Amber is a local-first desktop app that pulls a full iMessage/SMS conversation off an iPhone or a Mac, stores it in the durable open .amber archive format, and lets you browse it in an iMessage-style reader. Everything runs on-device - no cloud, no accounts, no telemetry.
